privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This explains what Dentiq stores about you and why. It is a working draft written for the current version of the app.
collect: Your name and email address, used to create your account and send verification messages.
A password hash. Your password itself is never stored.
Your role and approval status, so moderators can control access.
Session details (IP address and browser) used to keep you signed in and protect your account.
Files and notes you upload, with their title, course, version and source information.
Your language and theme choice, kept in your browser.
use: To run your account and show you course material you are allowed to see.
To let moderators review uploads before they are shared.
We do not sell your data and we do not show advertising.
privacy.private: Material you mark as personal stays visible only to you. Shared material is visible to approved users. Access is checked on the server, not only in the interface.
privacy.rights: You can download a copy of your data and delete your account yourself, as described above. For any other request about your data, use the contact below once it is filled in.
privacy.review: This draft has not been reviewed by a legal professional. It does not claim compliance with Quebec Law 25 or any other law.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These are the working rules for using Dentiq. They are a draft and will be reviewed before the public launch.

sections.title: Who can use Dentiq
sections.body: Dentiq is for dental students. Sign-up needs a university email address and an administrator's approval. You must give true information and keep your password private.

sections.title: Independent project
sections.body: Dentiq is an independent student project. It is not affiliated with, operated by or endorsed by any university or faculty. Dates, courses and other information taken from university pages may be out of date: always confirm them with your faculty.

sections.title: Your content
sections.body: You keep the rights to what you write. You promise that you have the right to upload anything you add, and that it does not infringe anyone's copyright, privacy or other rights. Notes are private by default. If you share a document or exam question, you allow Dentiq to show it to other approved users and to moderators for review.

sections.title: Exam questions and answers
sections.body: Answers are marked as proposed until a moderator verifies them. They can be wrong. Dentiq is a study aid, not an authoritative source: check your course material.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Do not upload recordings without the lecturer's permission, do not upload anything illegal, offensive or that identifies a patient, do not try to access other people's accounts or data, do not overload or attack the service, and do not copy shared material outside Dentiq against its owners' rights.

sections.title: Moderation
sections.body: Moderators and the administrator can review, hide or remove shared content and can suspend accounts that break these terms. Reports of copyright or other problems can be made from the content or through the Feedback button.

sections.title: No clinical advice
sections.body: Nothing in Dentiq is medical or dental advice. Never use it to decide on the treatment of a real patient.

sections.title: Availability and changes
sections.body: Dentiq is provided as is, free of charge, and may change, be interrupted or end. We try to keep your data safe but you should keep your own copies of important work; you can download your data from your profile.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: To the extent the law allows, Dentiq and the people who run it are not liable for losses from using the service or relying on its content. Nothing here limits rights you have under Quebec consumer or privacy law that cannot be waived.

sections.title: Ending your account
sections.body: You can delete your account at any time from your profile. We may suspend or remove accounts that break these terms.

sections.title: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Quebec and the federal laws of Canada that apply there. Disputes go to the competent courts of Quebec.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We will update this page when needed and show the date at the top. Continuing to use Dentiq after a change means you accept it.

exportDelete: From your profile you can download a JSON file with your own data: your profile and sign-in records, your uploads (names and details, not the files), exam questions you contributed, your notes and versions, your study data, your calendar entries and your tutor usage counts. It never contains your password or other people's data.

From your profile you can delete your account. This removes your account, sessions, notes, study data, calendar entries, tutor usage counts, personal documents and their files, and anything you submitted that was never published.

Documents and exam questions you contributed that were already published or hidden by a moderator stay, detached from your account, because other students may use them. Audit records stay without your name.
You can change your display name from your profile. Changing your email address is not available yet.

privacyMore.title: Who is responsible
privacyMore.body: Dentiq is an independent student project, not an organisation of a university. The person named under "Contact for privacy requests" below is responsible for the personal information described here and answers requests about it.

privacyMore.title: Cookies and similar storage
privacyMore.body: Dentiq sets only what it needs to work: a sign-in session cookie (secure, not readable by scripts), a language cookie, and a theme choice kept in your browser's local storage. There are no advertising, analytics or tracking cookies, and no third-party scripts, so there is no cookie banner. The offline feature stores a few public files in your browser cache.

privacyMore.title: Who processes your data (service providers)
privacyMore.body: To run the service we use: Vercel (hosting and file storage), Neon (database) and Resend (account emails: verification and password reset). They process data on our behalf. These providers may store data outside Quebec and outside Canada; the exact regions are to be confirmed before launch (UNVERIFIED). Your notes, recordings and calendar are not sent to any analytics or advertising service.

privacyMore.title: Recordings
privacyMore.body: Recordings are off unless the administrator turns them on. You may add one only with the lecturer's permission, and you confirm that when you upload. Only you can play or delete a recording, and nobody else sees it, including administrators. Recordings are never sent to a transcription service.

privacyMore.title: AI tutor
privacyMore.body: The AI tutor is built but switched off and no AI provider is connected. If it is ever switched on, nothing is sent until you accept a consent notice that explains what leaves Dentiq (your question and matching excerpts, possibly from your own notes), you can withdraw consent at any time, and your saved conversations can be downloaded or deleted. It never gives advice about real patients.

privacyMore.title: Health and patient information
privacyMore.body: Do not enter information that identifies a patient or any health information about a real person in notes, questions, feedback or the tutor. Dentiq is not designed to hold it.

privacyMore.title: How long we keep it
privacyMore.body: Your data is kept while your account exists. When you delete your account, your profile, notes, study data, calendar, recordings (and their files), tutor conversations, feedback and sign-in records are removed. Material you shared with others (approved documents and exam questions) may stay, without your name. Removed files are deleted from storage after a grace period of 30 days. Backups kept by our providers expire on their own schedule.

privacyMore.title: Security
privacyMore.body: Passwords are stored as hashes, connections use HTTPS, access is checked on every request, and private material is filtered by owner. No system is perfectly secure. If an incident creates a risk of serious harm, we will notify the people affected and the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec as the law requires.

privacyMore.title: Your rights
privacyMore.body: You can ask to see the personal information we hold about you, have it corrected, download it, withdraw consent, or have it deleted. You can do most of this yourself from your profile and settings. For anything else, use the contact below. You may also complain to the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec.

privacyMore.title: Age
privacyMore.body: Dentiq is meant for university students. If you are under 14, do not create an account.

privacyMore.title: Changes to this policy
privacyMore.body: We will update this page when the service changes and show the date at the top. Significant changes will be announced in the app.

uploadNotice.title: Before you upload
uploadNotice.noPatient: Do not upload anything that identifies a patient: no names, faces, clinical photos, radiographs or case files with identifiable details, chart numbers or dates of birth. Remove or blur them first. When in doubt, leave it out.
uploadNotice.permission: Only share what you have permission to share. By continuing you confirm that you do.
uploadNotice.report: Anyone can report an item, and moderators can take it down. If yours is taken down by mistake, you can appeal.

cookies.title: Cookies and tracking
cookies.intro: Dentiq uses only what is needed to run the site. It has no advertising, no analytics and no tracking scripts, and it loads nothing from other companies' servers.

items.name: Sign-in cookie (session)
items.body: Created when you sign in, so you stay signed in. It is removed when you sign out or delete your account, and it expires on its own. Dentiq cannot work without it while you are signed in.

items.name: Language cookie (DENTOS_LOCALE)
items.body: Remembers French or English for one year. It is created when you choose a language.

items.name: Theme setting (browser storage, dentos-theme)
items.body: Remembers light, dark or system. It stays on your device and is never sent to the server.

items.name: Offline cache (service worker)
items.body: Keeps a short list of public files (icons and the offline page) so the offline page can show. It never stores pages, documents, images or anything tied to your account.

none: No social network buttons or embedded third-party content.
cookies.choice: Because only the items above are used, there is no cookie banner. You can clear them at any time in your browser settings; you will have to sign in again.
cookies.update: If this ever changes, this page and the privacy policy will be updated first.

accessibility.title: Accessibility and feedback
accessibility.intro: We want every student to be able to use Dentiq. This page says what has been checked and what has not. It is not a certification and does not claim compliance with any standard.
checked: Keyboard use, with a visible focus outline and a skip-to-content link.
Page titles, one main heading per page, form labels and link names, in French and English.
Text contrast in light and dark themes, and layouts from 320 px wide.
gaps: Not tested with screen readers, or in Safari, Firefox or on real phones.
At very high zoom on a phone (about 195 px effective width) some selects are clipped.
No independent accessibility audit has been done.
accessibility.feedback: If something is hard to use, send feedback with the Feedback button on any page, or use the contact page. Say which page and what device or assistive tool you use.

contactPage.intro: Dentiq is an independent student project.

contactPage.report: To report a document or exam question, use the Report button on its page. A moderator reviews it, and the author can appeal.

definitions.title: What each number counts
definitions.attempt: A recorded answer is one question answered in practice or in a quiz. Answering the same question twice records two answers.
definitions.scored: A scored answer is an answer checked against a verified answer: correct, partly right or incorrect.
definitions.unscored: An unscored answer was given when the question had no verified answer. It is shown but never counted in any accuracy.
definitions.accuracy: Accuracy is points divided by scored answers, where correct is 1 point and partly right is half a point.
definitions.fixed: Whether an answer was scored is decided at the moment you answer. It is not recalculated if the question is edited later or its verification is removed.
definitions.activeDay: A day with activity has at least one recorded answer or card review.
definitions.due: A card is due when its scheduled review time has passed. New cards have no schedule yet and are counted apart.

how.title: How the tutor will work once it is switched on
how.sources: It will answer only from the sources above for the course you pick: official material first, then student-contributed material, then your own notes. Nobody else's private notes or documents are ever included.
how.citations: Every answer will list the passages it relies on, with a link to each. If no source supports an answer, it will say so instead of guessing.
how.current: Current-offering material is used by default. Previous offerings are only added when you ask, and are labelled.
how.limits: Planned limits: {limit, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} per student per day, and up to {chars} characters of sources sent with each question. An administrator can change both.
how.privacy: Only your question and the selected passages would leave this server, and only after an administrator turns the tutor on and a provider is configured. Today nothing leaves.

retention.title: File retention
retention.subtitle: Removed files and old note versions can be deleted for good. This page only reports until you apply.
retention.warning: Removed question images and removed documents keep their file for {days} days. After that, applying deletes the stored file for good; it cannot be recovered. Documents that are only hidden are never touched.
retention.fileLine: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to delete} one {# file to delete} other {# files to delete}} ({size}). Still within the grace period: {grace}.
retention.noteLine: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to delete} one {# version over the limit} other {# versions over the limit}}. The newest {max} versions of each note are kept, and the current version is never deleted.
retention.orphanLine: {count, plural, =0 {None found} one {# file found} other {# files found}} ({size}) with no matching record and older than {days} days. Reported only.
retention.orphansTruncated: The scan stopped early; there may be more.
retention.orphansUnavailable: This storage cannot be scanned for orphaned files.
retention.batchNote: Each run handles at most {batch} items per category. Run it again to continue.
retention.applyHelp: Deletes the files and versions counted above. Every run is recorded in the audit history with counts only.
retention.confirm: I understand that this permanently deletes files.
retention.confirmOrphans: Also delete the orphaned files found (optional).
retention.doneDetail: {files, plural, =0 {No files deleted} one {# file deleted} other {# files deleted}}, {noteVersions, plural, =0 {no note versions deleted} one {# note version deleted} other {# note versions deleted}}, {orphans, plural, =0 {no orphaned files deleted} one {# orphaned file deleted} other {# orphaned files deleted}}. {failed, plural, =0 {} one {# deletion failed and will be retried next run.} other {# deletions failed and will be retried next run.}}

errors.confirmRequired: Tick the confirmation box to apply.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Dentiq
onboarding.intro: Three quick questions so the app fits your program. Everything is optional and you can change it later.
onboarding.universityHelp: Presets only prefill suggestions. Check dates and courses with your faculty.
onboarding.semesterHelp: 1 is the first semester of your year, and so on.
onboarding.error: We could not save your answers. Check the choices and try again.

help.title: Help
help.intro: Short answers about how Dentiq works.

start.title: Getting started
start.body: Pick your courses from the Courses page, then add notes or browse past exam questions (passes). Your answers to the first-run questions only personalize suggestions.

notes.title: Notes
notes.body: Notes are private to you unless you choose to share a document. Each save keeps a version you can go back to.

passes.title: Passes
passes.body: Passes are past exam questions. An answer is marked proposed until a moderator verifies it; always check with your course material.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.body: The calendar shows only entries you add. Dates from presets must be confirmed with your faculty.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Your notes and study data are private and are not sent to any third party. You can export or delete your data from your profile.

account.title: Account
account.body: Change your name, download your data or delete your account from the Profile page.

schedule.title: My schedule
schedule.subtitle: Your class times, with the terms and breaks of your university.
schedule.verifyBody: Term dates, breaks and exam periods come from public university pages and may change or be incomplete. Always confirm them with your faculty. You can add or change your own class times at any time.

terms.title: Current and next term
terms.help: From the university preset you chose.
terms.noPreset: Choose a university in Help > Change my program details to see its term dates.
terms.none: No term data is loaded yet for your university.
terms.unverified: Not confirmed: check with your faculty

blocks.title: Weekly class times
blocks.emptyBody: Add each class below, or import a calendar file (.ics) from your university or another app.

follow.title: Courses for your year and semester
follow.help: Courses listed for year {year} in the catalog. Following one is only for you.
follow.noProfile: Tell us your program year in Help > Change my program details to see suggestions.
follow.empty: No courses are listed in the catalog for your year and semester yet.

import.title: Import or export
import.help: Import an .ics file you chose. Nothing is fetched from the internet and no login is used.
import.hint: Up to 512 KB. Weekly events become class times; other events become calendar entries.
import.done: Imported {entries} entries and {blocks} class times. Skipped: {skipped}.

errors.nothingToImport: No usable event was found in this file.
errors.fileTooLarge: This file is too large (512 KB maximum).
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many imports. Try again in a minute.
errors.limitReached: You reached the limit of class times.
errors.forbidden: Your account must be approved first.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.

recordings.title: Recordings
recordings.subtitle: Your own lecture recordings, private to you.
recordings.noAccess: Your account must be approved before you can use recordings.
recordings.privacy: Only you can see, play or delete your recordings, not even the administrator. They are never sent to a transcription or AI service.
recordings.off: The administrator has not turned recordings on, so you cannot add new ones. Existing recordings stay available to you.

list.title: Your recordings
list.emptyBody: Add a lecture you are allowed to record. You can play it back at your own speed and write notes against moments in it.
list.emptyOff: Recordings are not turned on yet.

form.heading: Add a recording
form.help: Audio (mp3, m4a, wav, ogg, webm) or video (mp4, webm).
form.title: Title
form.fileHint: Audio files only (MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG). Up to {max} MB. Private to you.
form.drop: Drag an audio file here, or choose one.

consent.title: Before you add it
consent.intro: Recording a lecture needs the lecturer's permission. Tick each box to continue.
consent.recordingAllowed: I am allowed to record this lecture.
consent.lecturerPermission: The lecturer agreed that I may record it for my own study.
consent.privateUse: I will keep it private and will not share it.

notes.title: Your notes
notes.emptyBody: Write a note, and optionally the second it refers to.

delete.title: Delete this recording
delete.help: Removes the file and your notes for good. Consent was confirmed on {date}.

errors.disabled: Recordings are switched off by the administrator.
errors.forbidden: Your account must be approved first.
errors.consentRequired: Tick all three boxes to confirm you may record and keep this lecture.
errors.fileTooLarge: This file is larger than the limit.
errors.fileType: This file is not a supported audio or video format.
errors.quotaExceeded: This would go over your storage space. Delete a recording first.
errors.invalid: Something in the form is not valid.

admin.title: Recordings
admin.adminHelp: Switch recordings on or off and set size limits.
admin.subtitle: Lecture recordings are OFF by default.
admin.warning: Recordings are private personal data (Quebec Law 25) and need the lecturer's permission. Each student must tick a consent checklist when uploading. Turning this on does not enable transcription: no provider exists.
admin.quotaHint: Must be at least the largest file.
admin.outOfRange: These values are out of range.
admin.hosting: Hosting: files use the Blob store (free tier about 1 GB in total) and, on Vercel, a request body is limited to 4.5 MB, so large uploads only work locally until direct-to-storage uploads are built. See docs/recordings.md.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.thanksBody: Your message was sent. We read every one.
feedback.warning: Do not include passwords, health information or anything that identifies a patient.
feedback.messageHint: At least 5 and at most {max} characters.
feedback.emailHint: Only if you want an answer.
feedback.pageNote: We attach the page you are on ({path}), without anything after the address.

errors.invalidType: Choose what the message is about.
errors.messageTooShort: Write at least a few words.
errors.invalidEmail: That email address does not look right.
errors.tooMany: You sent several messages recently. Try again later.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

landing.metaTitle: Dentiq: a study space for dental students
landing.metaDescription: Private course notes, past exam questions with moderator-verified answers, a personal calendar and flashcards for dental students, in French and English.
landing.heroBody: Keep your course notes, practise with past exam questions, plan your terms and review with flashcards. Everything is in French and English, and your notes stay private.
landing.heroNote: Independent student project, starting with the D.M.D. at Université de Montréal. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any university. Sign-up needs a university email address and an administrator's approval.

notes.title: Private notes
notes.body: Write notes per course. They are private to you, and every save keeps a version you can go back to.

passes.title: Past exam questions
passes.body: Browse and practise questions by course and year. Answers are marked proposed until a moderator verifies them.

calendar.title: A calendar that is yours
calendar.body: Add your exams, class times and study sessions. Term dates and breaks from official university pages are shown with a reminder to confirm them with your faculty.

practice.title: Flashcards and quizzes
practice.body: Turn questions and your own cards into short review sessions and see your own progress.

one.title: Create your account
one.body: Use your university email address, confirm it, then wait for an administrator to approve you.

two.title: Tell us your program
two.body: Pick your year and semester so Dentiq can suggest your courses. You can skip this.

three.title: Study
three.body: Add notes, practise questions and plan your weeks. Nothing you write is shared unless you choose to share it.

who.a: Dental students with a university email address, after an administrator approves the account. It starts with the D.M.D. program at Université de Montréal.

private.a: Yes. Notes, calendar entries, flashcards and recordings belong to you and are not shown to other students. Nothing is sent to an analytics or advertising service.

answers.q: Can I trust the exam answers?
answers.a: Not blindly. An answer stays marked as a proposal until a moderator verifies it and notes the basis. Always check against your course material.

ai.a: Not today. An AI tutor is built but switched off, and no AI service is connected. If it is ever turned on, you will be asked for your explicit consent first.

official.q: Is this an official university service?
official.a: No. It is an independent student project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any university. Confirm dates and course lists with your faculty.

seo.signIn: Sign in to Dentiq to open your course notes, past exam questions, calendar and flashcards.
seo.signUp: Create a Dentiq account with your university email address. An administrator approves new accounts.
seo.privacy: How Dentiq handles your personal data: what is stored, who can see it and how to export or delete it. Draft, pending legal review.
seo.terms: The terms of using Dentiq, an independent student study project. Draft, pending legal review.
seo.forgot: Ask for a link to choose a new Dentiq password.

appeals.title: Contest this decision
appeals.help: A moderator hid or rejected this item. Explain why you think that was a mistake. An administrator will review it.
appeals.sent: Appeal sent. An administrator will review it.

errors.invalid: This appeal could not be sent.
errors.alreadyOpen: You already have an open appeal for this item.

appeals.queueHelp: Decisions by moderators that the author contests. Upholding an appeal republishes the item.
